content: You will be given an argumentation and asked about to find the relation from relation types: sup (support), exa (support by example), add (additional source), reb (rebutting attack), und (undercutting attack), joint (joining relation) between two selected argument components from it.

Anti-virus software protects the users of a computer from dangers from the internet. That's why everyone should have an anti-virus programme on his or her Windows machine. Admittedly they do not generally prevent you from catching a virus, since they can only react to publicly known threats. But once a safeguard has been found against a new virus, everyone gets it in no time through the automatic update.
What is the relation between "Anti-virus software protects the users of a computer from dangers from the internet." and "since they can only react to publicly known threats." from the above essay? Choose from following options 1. reb
2. und
3. joint
4. exa
5. sup
6. no relation
